selection_rationale: C1 directly targets the central programmatic gap (verifier-grounded Generate–Verify–Repair applied across heterogeneous multi‑vendor templates and topologies), uses a paired, falsifiable design with operational emulation outcomes (policy-violation rate) closely aligned to the CNSM NetOps reliability remit, and is feasible within the stated resource envelope; reviewers rated its venue relevance and falsifiability highest, making it the strongest defensible submission after fixes.
unresolved_uncertainties: How well verifier-assisted GVR generalizes across real multi-vendor hardware quirks versus Mininet-simulated templates (scaling/generalization to production devices).
Extent to which deterministic verifiers can detect high-level semantic/policy violations (false assurance risk) and how to adjudicate ambiguous cases.
Impact of hosted-LLM nondeterminism on measured GVR gains and exact reproducibility of paired comparisons.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify exact LLM model identifier(s), endpoint(s), temperature and seeding policy, and a deterministic retry/re-run policy (including maximum retries and retry-trigger rules).
Add verifier-adjudication for semantic/policy checks: formalize policy rules where possible and add an adjudication protocol (automated + human spot-checks) for ambiguous verifier outcomes.
Provide explicit sample-size / power calculations for the paired McNemar and Wilcoxon targets and for planned subgroup analyses; adjust task count if required.

Broaden or document vendor-template selection: preregister stratified vendor/template sampling and include at least one hardware-proximate variability test or clearly state the limitation if hardware testing is infeasible.

Define handling of hosted-LLM nondeterminism in analysis (e.g., repeated-baseline runs, variance quantification) and preregister procedures for API failures, rate limits, and allowed technical restarts.
Extend verifier coverage or document verifier limits (syntax, reachability, ACL) and preregister a procedure to record verifier false-negative/false-positive rates via adjudication samples.
